agent_profiles_limits.name: agent_profiles_limits
agent_profiles_limits.value: ("agent_profiles"."max_duration_ms" IS NULL OR "agent_profiles"."max_duration_ms" > 0) AND ("agent_profiles"."max_cost_micros" IS NULL OR "agent_profiles"."max_cost_micros" > 0)

contact_roles_target.name: contact_roles_target
contact_roles_target.value: ("contact_roles"."scope" = 'company' AND "contact_roles"."company_id" IS NOT NULL AND "contact_roles"."project_id" IS NULL AND "contact_roles"."task_id" IS NULL) OR ("contact_roles"."scope" = 'project' AND "contact_roles"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "contact_roles"."company_id" IS NULL AND "contact_roles"."task_id" IS NULL) OR ("contact_roles"."scope" = 'task' AND "contact_roles"."task_id" IS NOT NULL AND "contact_roles"."company_id" IS NULL AND "contact_roles"."project_id" IS NULL)

members_identity.name: members_identity
members_identity.value: ("members"."kind" = 'person' AND "members"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("members"."kind" = 'agent' AND "members"."user_id" IS NULL)

projects_contract.name: projects_contract
projects_contract.value: "projects"."contract_amount" IS NULL OR ("projects"."contract_amount" >= 0 AND "projects"."currency" IS NOT NULL)

task_calendar_rrule.name: task_calendar_rrule
task_calendar_rrule.value: "task_calendar"."rrule" IS NULL OR length("task_calendar"."rrule") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

task_dependencies_self.name: task_dependencies_self
task_dependencies_self.value: "task_dependencies"."predecessor_task_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "task_dependencies"."successor_task_id" OR "task_dependencies"."predecessor_task_id" IS NULL

task_dependencies_self_milestone.name: task_dependencies_self_milestone
task_dependencies_self_milestone.value: "task_dependencies"."predecessor_milestone_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "task_dependencies"."successor_milestone_id" OR "task_dependencies"."predecessor_milestone_id" IS NULL
